name: Dark Memory
storyline: The kingdom of Vharan shattered in a single night. No one remembers how, and no one remembers you. You wake up nameless in the Forest of Awakening, with a wound no one can explain and a blade waiting on the trail. To the north, Vharan is the last city still standing. Each region of the fallen kingdom guards a piece of what happened that night, and every boss you defeat returns a fragment of your lost memory. But as the memories return, a darker question grows: not every memory that comes back is yours.
summary: Dark Memory is an isometric dark fantasy action RPG. You wake up nameless in the Forest of Awakening, with a wound no one can explain and a blade on the trail. To the north lies Vharan, the last city still standing in a kingdom that shattered in a single night. Each region holds a piece of what happened, and every boss you defeat returns a fragment of memory. But not every memory that comes back is yours. Play as a Warrior or a Druid, hunt loot, craft gear and face brutal bosses across Act I.
